S30.28.needs: a request that makes a .pptx file; the app must produce one, which the extension code does not do itself
S30.28.note: The extension has no PPTX-specific code: any produced file gets this card and Download button (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/generatedFiles.ts:274 and bubbles.ts:730). The saved name keeps the file's own name, so the .pptx extension depends on the backend naming it; the button is icon-only, so its visible words are only a tooltip and aria label. The plan's 'Where to find it: not written yet' line is stale. Searched for pptx and presentation in apps/extension and packages/ui/unified-chat.
steps: Sign in to the AGI Chrome side panel and open a new chat.
Ask the assistant to make a presentation (a deck) and wait for the answer to finish.
Look under the answer for the "Files from this answer" list and find the card for the .pptx file.
Click the Download icon button on that card (its tooltip reads "Download <file name>").
Check that the browser saves a .pptx file with the deck's name and that the status line under the card does not show a failure message.
S30.28.where: Side panel chat > ask for a presentation to be made > under the answer, the "Files from this answer" list > the Download icon button on the .pptx file card (tooltip "Download $FILE$")
